full_prompt_en: A square painted illustration shows a young woman seated in profile at the edge of a dense garden. She faces right with a quiet, level gaze and her hands resting together across a pale ocher skirt. A dark olive cap covers most of her hair, leaving a smooth brown coil near her ear. Her long white sleeves contrast with a fitted green-brown bodice and a deep charcoal outer skirt. A small white lamb lowers its head beside her left knee, partly hidden among broad gray-green leaves. Clusters of orange and muted yellow flowers gather at the lower left, while a round orange fruit rests near the lower right corner amid curling stems. Behind her, low green ground recedes in horizontal bands. Thin dark tree trunks rise at the far left, and a patchwork of pale cream, gray, and warm stone-colored rectangles fills the upper background. The woman’s face is softly modeled, but her profile remains clean and deliberate. The surrounding foliage is built from flatter, overlapping shapes with dark outlines and small warm highlights. Brushwork is visible as short, textured marks through the leaves and garments; the pale background is calmer and more planar. Light is diffuse and even, making the white sleeve, lamb, and light stone blocks stand out without hard cast shadows. The palette rests on subdued greens, cream, and ocher, punctuated by saturated orange blossoms and fruit. A compact foreground and shallow, layered background keep the figure visually central while giving the garden a decorative, almost tapestry-like density.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形绘画插画呈现一位年轻女子侧身坐在茂密花园边缘。她朝向右侧，目光平静而平视，双手相叠放在浅赭色裙面上。深橄榄色软帽遮住大半头发，耳边留下一圈光滑棕发。长白袖与贴身绿棕色上衣、深炭灰外裙形成对比。一只白色小羊在她左膝旁低头，部分身躯藏在宽大的灰绿叶片间。橘色与暗黄色花簇聚在左下，右下角有一枚圆橘色果实，周围绕着卷曲的茎叶。人物后方的低矮绿地以水平色带后退。左远处几根纤细深色树干升起，上部背景则由淡奶油、灰色与暖石色矩形拼接而成。女子脸部柔和塑形，侧影仍干净明确。周围叶丛由较平的重叠形块组成，带深色边线和少量暖色亮点。叶片与衣料里可见短促、有肌理的笔痕；浅色背景更平静、更平面。光漫散而均匀，使白袖、小羊及浅色石块突出，却不形成硬投影。配色以低饱和绿、奶油色和赭色为基底，用饱和橘色花朵和果实作重音。紧密前景和浅而分层的背景让人物成为视觉中心，同时让花园拥有近似挂毯的装饰密度。
style_prompt_en: A painted illustrative surface combines careful contour drawing with matte, lightly textured color. Muted olive, sage, cream, and ocher occupy broad linked areas; small orange accents concentrate along the lower edges and give the palette its pulse. Foreground shapes overlap densely and carry short, irregular brush marks and occasional dark linear seams. A central curved silhouette is modeled more softly than the surrounding flattened forms, creating a gentle focal hierarchy without breaking the decorative unity. The upper zone resolves into quiet rectangular color blocks, while thin vertical marks at one edge add measured rhythm. Diffuse daylight keeps the value range moderate: pale areas lift cleanly from deeper green and charcoal, with few sharp shadows. Space remains shallow and layered, balancing precise profile edges against loose foliage-like clusters and subdued surface grain.
style_prompt_zh: 绘画插画表面把谨慎的轮廓线与哑光、略带肌理的色层结合。低饱和橄榄绿、鼠尾草绿、奶油色和赭色占据宽阔相连的区域；少量橘色重音集中在下部边缘，让配色产生脉动。前景形块密集叠压，带短小不规则笔痕和偶尔出现的深色线缝。中央弧形剪影比周围较平的形体塑造得更柔，形成温和的视觉层级，同时保留装饰性的统一感。上部区域化为安静的矩形色块，一侧纤细竖向痕迹增加有节制的节奏。漫射日光让明度范围保持适中：浅色区域从较深的绿色和炭灰中干净地浮起，尖锐阴影很少。空间浅而分层，在精确的侧面边缘、松散的簇状形块和克制的表面颗粒之间取得平衡。
theme_en: A seated woman among garden foliage with a small white lamb
theme_zh: 坐在花园叶丛中的女子与一只白色小羊
name: Edward Okun
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
